the role of nutritional antioxidants and the mechanisms involved with hormetic responses to dietary antioxidants.

the identification and quantitation of hormetic effects of dietary factors and nutritional interventions on health and disease, with a particular emphasis on the hormetic effects of antioxidants and the mechanisms involved in the regulation of the vitagenes.

the identification and quantification of hormetic effects of dietary antioxidants and other factors on health and longevity, with particular emphasis on the role of hormesis in neurodegeneration, cancer and aging.

the hormetic role of antioxidants and the hormetic role in the control of energy intake are both important in the maintenance of health and the prevention of age-related chronic diseases.

dietary antioxidants can be beneficial to the organism when consumed in the appropriate doses.
